name: Tobe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tobe town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a three-armed device.
history: Municipal flag of Tobe, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 2005; the emblem dates from 1935.

features.role: Tobe town emblem — an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a three-armed device
